snippet.title: The Hood: The World is His | Character Reveal Trailer | Marvel Rivals
snippet.description:
From the shadows of the New York underground comes the newest power-hungry villain. 🔥
 
Cloaked in a cursed mantle, Parker Robbins lost his faith in heroes alongside his father and his world's Captain America - replacing it with an insatiable appetite for the power to change the world. Stealing an enchanted cloak from the Vault, he remade himself as the feared crime lord, The Hood.
 
Now, The Hood treads a perilous path through channeling dark magic, devouring enemy firepower, and transforming into a demonic abomination of cosmic magic and steel. snippet.title: Violent Night 2 | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Merry Christmas to all, and to all a good fight. Violent Night 2 only in theaters December 4.

If you’re nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you’re naughty, you get justice. 

David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North—the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde and the Nobody franchise—and returning action director Tommy Wirkola. 

In 2022’s bare-knuckle holiday sensation, Violent Night, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall. 

But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell).  

Along with David Harbour, Jared Harris and Kristen Bell, the dynamic cast includes Emmy winning screen legend Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2). 

Violent Night 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film’s returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures.

Having earned over $740 million at the global box office, the Insidious franchise returns with a new family and a terror that redefines what The Further is capable of.
 
In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.
 
With Lin Shaye reprising her iconic role as Elise Rainier and Jacob Chase (Come Play) directing, Insidious: Out of the Further opens August 21, 2026. Screenplay by Jacob Chase. Story by David Leslie Johnson-McGoldrick and Jacob Chase.

snippet.title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER [Official Trailer] - In Theaters Worldwide Sept. 30
snippet.description:

Directed by Joe Hahn. Experience UNSHATTER in theaters worldwide for a limited run beginning September 30. Tickets on sale August 13. Sign up for early access to tickets at http://unshattermovie.com.

The UNSHATTER Film Soundtrack (Live in São Paulo) is out September 25, featuring career-spanning live tracks recorded at our FROM ZERO album release show in November 2024. Pre-order now at https://lprk.co/unshattersoundtrack.

snippet.title: The Search For The Leviathan
snippet.description:
In the last few months, hundreds of reports have appeared all over the internet, all claiming to see the same thing in their Minecraft oceans - a sea monster called The Leviathan. But is it just a massive hoax, or is there something more to it? I'm going to find out.

Voice of Hummer:  @schpoody 
Voice of Arronax:  @jumperwho 

ORIGINAL MUSIC BY: Ben Bracey (@benbraceymusic on instagram)
https://soundcloud.com/benbraceymusic/sets/hunting-the-leviathan-original

Download all the builds in this video for $5 on both Java and Bedrock!!: https://maps.wifies.net/products/the-leviathan  



DO NOT READ BELOW FOR SPOILERS:


Well well well here we are again. I think this video is interesting in that the first 12 minutes can't prepare you for the remaining hour; as in the pacing is very different/the style totally shifts. So we'll see how that goes...

I'm really fond of the ending I like how that last 10 minutes turned out. That final scene with hummer was inspired by one of my favorite short stories, "Hell is the Absence of God" by Ted Chiang. There are definitely some parts of the video that I think could be a little better like maybe the dialogue is a bit dragged but overall I'm pretty satisfied with the majority of the video. 

Thematically, I think you might be able to tell the kind of story I was playing around with, but I was also hugely inspired by the Lochness Monster. Probably some of my favorite parts of research for this video was reading the Lochness Monster wiki and learning more about the kind of theories/tools people use to look for it. The F3 scene on hummer's boat was inspired by all the sonar and stuff people use to check for Nessie.

Also just a MASSIVE shoutout to schpood for all the hours and care he poured into this video. I'm so thankful for the enthusiasm and feedback he gave and the video would be so much worse without him. And thank you to my discord server members for making (almost) all of the fake reports you see in this video. They were super creative and did a way better job than I could have. 


➤➤ Twitter: https://twitter.com/wifiestwt
➤➤ Discord: https://discord.gg/zAWUuWb


➤➤Links: 

Want to listen to or license the music I use? Check it out here: https://www.epidemicsound.com/community/playlist/?_us=Affiliate&_usx=1xis5q&utm_source=1xis5q&utm_medium=organicambassador&utm_campaign=1xis5q&playlist=uad3vzakh605efvoqoi24llhnpr9lm2y

LEMMiNO - Blackout
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RsVVcsVDt-s
CC BY-SA 4.0

Water Lantern designed by: @MythicalPingu 

Submarine tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ud22yz0p7s


All screenshots/reddit posts/websites in this video do NOT exist and were made for the sake of the video. If any link redirects to an actual website - that is coincidental and do not treat it as "official";  it was just put in the video make the world feel more real. 

This is NOT series called Minecraft VVSauce where I explore random features of Minecraft. Not Secret Minecraft things or Minecraft lore (like Game Theory) or Escape Rooms, but an ARG that isn't an ARG but it's actually unfiction - a genre pretending to be real that isn't real but we all pretend to be real. This is the search for the leviathan. I hope you enjoy

snippet.title: Nikos x Yraa - Ochii care nu se vad | Videoclip Oficial
snippet.description:
🔔 Abonează-te gratuit la canal.

Spuneti-vă vă rog părerea despre această piesă frumoasă într-un comentariu scurt.

Versuri:
La început eram tot, zi și noapte,
Acum suntem „poate”, „mai târziu”, „mergem mai departe”.
Mesaje rare, voci schimbate,
Parcă ne vorbim din alte vieți uitate.

Te văd online, dar nu cu mine,
Ești aproape, dar prea departe de mine.
Îți spun „mi-e dor”, îmi spui „și mie”,
Dar dorul nostru nu mai știe cei bine.

Distanța n-a fost doar în kilometri,
A fost timp, tăcere și secrete.
Și fără să ne dăm seama când,
Ne-am pierdut puțin câte puțin.

Ochii care nu se văd se uită,
Poate tu ai reușit.
Eu încă te port în suflet,
Ca în prima zi când te-am văzut.

Ochii care nu se văd se uită,
Și noi am fost o clipă.
Frumoasă, rară, dar pierdută,
Ca o iubire nevăzută.

Am crescut separat, fără să știm,
Tu în altă lume, eu alt destin.
Nu ne-am certat, nu ne-am urât,
Doar ne-am răcit… și ne-am pierdut.

Îți mai știu vocea, dar parcă nu,
Îți știu numele, dar nu mai știu „tu”.
Și cel mai greu nu-i că ai plecat,
Ci că ai dat pas la tot ce am visat.

Versuri:
La început eram tot, zi și noapte,
Acum suntem „poate”, „mai târziu”, „mergem mai departe”.
Mesaje rare, voci schimbate,
Parcă ne vorbim din alte vieți uitate.

Te văd online, dar nu cu mine,
Ești aproape, dar prea departe de mine.
Îți spun „mi-e dor”, îmi spui „și mie”,
Dar dorul nostru nu mai știe cei bine.

Distanța n-a fost doar în kilometri,
A fost timp, tăcere și secrete.
Și fără să ne dăm seama când,
Ne-am pierdut puțin câte puțin.

Ochii care nu se văd se uită,
Poate tu ai reușit.
Eu încă te port în suflet,
Ca în prima zi când te-am văzut.

Ochii care nu se văd se uită,
Și noi am fost o clipă.
Frumoasă, rară, dar pierdută,
Ca o iubire nevăzută.

Am crescut separat, fără să știm,
Tu în altă lume, eu alt destin.
Nu ne-am certat, nu ne-am urât,
Doar ne-am răcit… și ne-am pierdut.

Îți mai știu vocea, dar parcă nu,
Îți știu numele, dar nu mai știu „tu”.
Și cel mai greu nu-i că ai plecat,
Ci că ai dat pas la tot ce am visat.

snippet.description:
Forever Mine is an emotional uplifting trance journey about finding the one person your soul has been searching for all along. Built around soaring female vocals, euphoric melodies, cinematic atmospheres, and powerful uplifting energy, the track captures the feeling of knowing that true love isn't just a moment—it's forever.

Some hearts meet by chance.

Others were always meant to find each other.

Across every mile.

Every season.

Every lifetime.

Driven by emotional breakdowns, shimmering synths, uplifting trance melodies, and euphoric drops, Forever Mine tells the story of two souls bound by an unbreakable connection, where every embrace feels like coming home and every heartbeat promises a future together.

Every sunrise feels brighter.

Every dream becomes clearer.

Every moment says the same words.

You were always...

Forever Mine.

For the dreamers who believe in soulmates.

For the hearts that never stop believing in forever.

For the souls who know that real love doesn't fade—it only grows stronger with time.

Close your eyes.

Hold on tight.

Feel every heartbeat.

And believe in...

Forever Mine.

ABOUT THE THING THAT HAPPENED:
In a post-apocalyptic world, Marcus Draven who arrived in the city of Jericho. The city was in ruins, with remnants of an old civilization scattered everywhere. Marcus had been traveling for days, scavenging for food and supplies to survive in this harsh new world.
As Marcus entered Jericho, he was met with a desolate landscape - crumbling buildings, overgrown vegetation, and a sense of eerie silence. The once bustling city was now a ghost town, haunted by the memories of its former glory.
Though the world around them remained harsh and unforgiving, the spirit of resilience and community in Jericho served as a beacon of hope in the face of adversity. Marcus journey in the post-apocalyptic city of Jericho was a testament to the human capacity for survival, adaptation, and the enduring will to rebuild even in the bleakest of circumstances.

Quality of Life Preview 2 🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/739630/view/690889040713482424?l=english

General fixes for player character, equipment, ghosts, locations, and VR.

Welcome back, Ghost Hunters.

Adding key binds for Equipment slots. PC players will be able to switch Equipment with the 1, 2, 3 and 4 keys. These keys can be rebound.

This addition will only be available for PC players.

Adding a key bind to be able to inspect the Watch at any time.

This will be defaulted to Left DPAD on a controller and H on keyboard. Players can rebind this via Options then Controls.

A separate Photo can now be taken capturing an EMF Level 5 reading.

Photo Cameras will now feature the same highlight frame as Video Cameras. 

On screen indicator only on Tier 2 and 3 Photo Cameras, while Tier 1 will have the light change color.

When capturing Media, if multiple are present, the evidence that provides the biggest reward or is Unique will be prioritized.

New Ghost: the Deildegast 

Players will have a higher chance of getting this Ghost in their contracts for the first few weeks following release.

----------

Phasmophobia on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/739630/Phasmophobia/

Phasmophobia is a 4 player online co-op psychological horror. Paranormal activity is on the rise and it’s up to you and your team to use all the ghost-hunting equipment at your disposal in order to gather as much evidence as you can.

Immersive Experience: Realistic graphics and sounds as well as a minimal user interface ensure a totally immersive experience that will keep you on your toes.

Unique Ghosts: Identify over 20 different ghost types, each with unique traits, personalities, and abilities to make each investigation feel different from the last.

Equipment: Use well-known ghost-hunting equipment such as EMF Readers, Spirit Boxes, Thermometers, and Night Vision Cameras to find clues and gather as much paranormal evidence as you can. Find Cursed Possessions that grant information or abilities in exchange for your sanity.

Locations: Choose from over 10 different haunted locations, each with unique twists, hiding spots, and layouts.

Game Modes: With 5 default difficulties and hand crafted weekly challenges, there are plenty of ways to test your skills.

Teamwork: Dive in head first, get your hands dirty searching for evidence while fighting for your life. If you're not feeling up to the task, play it safe and support your team from the truck by monitoring the investigation with CCTV and motion sensors.

Custom Difficulty: Create your own games to tailor the difficulty to your or your group's needs, with proportional rewards and come up with crazy game modes of your own!

Co-operate: Play alongside your friends with up to 4 players in this co-op horror where teamwork is key to your success.

Play together: Phasmophobia supports all players together, play with your friends with any combination of input types.
----------
#phasmophobia  #indiehorror  #ghosthunting

snippet.title: Wyrmscraig Just Launched... Here's EVERYTHING That Changed | ft. Settled & ScreteMongee
snippet.description:
Embark on a journey to the mysterious, community-designed island of Wyrmscraig with @Settledrs and designer of the island @ScreteMonge (Gnome). Complete the new quest, Fallen From Grace, then take on a challenging repeatable boss "The Mad Angel" for a chance to earn the powerful Hallowfell sword. Meet Mortimer, the island's Slayer Master, craft your own Golems, hunt goats, and uncover hidden lore scattered throughout Wyrmscraig. What secrets will you uncover?

🪨 Read our recent Wyrmscraig update blog here: https://t.co/qYIv1l1qtl

🏝️ Read the launch overview blog here: https://osrs.game/Wyrmscraig-Out-Today

Old School RuneScape is a retro game version of RuneScape from 2007 which we returned at the community's request. The community controls the developmental direction of Old School RuneScape by voting on which updates it would like to receive.

The world's largest and most popular MMORPG, Old School RuneScape has been played by over 260 million players since the 2001 release of RuneScape. Old School RuneScape unites the intricate mechanics of modern MMOs with the nostalgic point-and-click gameplay of early role-playing games.

Old School RuneScape is free to download and play, however, the game also offers players the opportunity to purchase in-game items. Please see the PEGI information page for more information: https://pegi.info/search-pegi?q=runescape

The world's largest and most popular MMORPG, Old School RuneScape has been played by over 260 million players since the 2001 release of RuneScape. Old School RuneScape unites the intricate mechanics of modern MMOs with the nostalgic point-and-click gameplay of early role-playing games.
